name: example-style-retro-futurism
title: Retro-Futurism Style
description: Retro-futurism (synthwave / cyberpunk) style showroom: deep black #1A1A2E base, neon blue / hot pink / cyan glow via text-shadow and box-shadow, CRT scanline overlay, glitch keyframes, striped retro sun over a perspective grid floor, monospace + Orbitron type, shown as a synthwave music-festival promo page. Use when the brief mentions "synthwave", "retro-futurism", "cyberpunk", "vaporwave", "80s neon", "outrun", "CRT". Based on nextlevelbuilder's UI UX Pro Max style library.

query.en: Make a synthwave music festival promo page with neon glow, a retro sun, CRT scanlines and a glitching title.
